 Series:  ACC Men's U19 Asia Cup 2026 •
 Venue:  Al Amerat Cricket Ground (Ministry Turf 2), Al Amerat •
 Date & Time:    Info Live Scorecard Squads Points Table Overs Graphs Highlights Full Commentary News   Match starts at Nov 14, 05:00 GMT Head-to-head: Both sides have met each other in 31 matches, with India winning 17, Pakistan taking 13 and 1 no result. But since 2021, India have won only twice in 7 attempts. If you have a good pace attack, bowling first good be a good option as the new ball has moved a tad extra due to the early morning moisture than the second innings. India opted to bat against Pakistan in the group stage and found themselves in a lot of trouble. Will they take that risky call again? When these two sides met in the group stage, we got a tough game. Both sides threw punches, but Pakistan eventually got everything together at the end and recorded an impressive win. What's in store today? A warm welcome to this all important final. Squads: India U19 Squad: Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani(c), Aaryavir Sehwag, VK Vineeth, Yashbardhan Chauhan, Arjun Rajput, Anvay Dravid(w), Manal Chauhan, Mohit Ulva, Aryan Savsani, Kavya Patel, Ishan Sood, Kushagra Ojha, Rajat Baghel, Shavin Vinodh, Yashveer Goud Pakistan U19 Squad: Usman Khan, Hayam Khan, Abdul Qadir, Farhan Yousaf(c), Ahmed Hussain, Ali Raza, Hamza Zahoor(w), Hasnain Abbas Dar, Mohammad Sayyam, Rizwanullah, Niqab Shafiq, Jahangir Bilal, Huzaifa Ahsan, Mohammad Huzaifa, Abdul Subhan FEATURED VIDEOS
